question: Are published spending-composition profiles closer at road-neighbor municipalities than under whole-profile permutations among nearly equal-Total municipalities in the same supplier region?

source_periods.dictionary: unique annual active supplier record for 2024

admission: all six published values present, finite and positive
unique active2024 supplier dictionary row; native territory_id exact join
shape=1 only; remove endpoints of zero highway distance between eligible shape1 centers WITHIN THE SAME region
retain largest connected within-region highway component; ties by minimum supplier ID; require complete positive pair distances inside it
at least12 eligible per region before matching
sort by (published Total, numeric supplierID) within each month and region; consecutive pairs, last triple if odd
discard entire block if max Total / min Total > 1.10; do not rematch
retain region only if at least12 IDs after matching
profile: CLR of the five selected categories only: log(v_c) minus mean log(selected five). Squared Euclidean CLR distance divided by5. No extra deflator, no sum-as-Total, no derived remainder category.
graph: Directed k road-nearest centers within the ADMITTED SAME-REGION SAMPLE (not all Russian municipalities), with all ties at kth distance included; no added links or fitted geometry; each source ID row normalized by its actual neighbor count.
statistic: Within each region D=mean_ID(mean_neighbors squared CLR distance). E=exact expectation under independent uniform whole-profile permutations within registered level blocks. Regional gain=1-D/E. Primary gain=unweighted mean regional gain. ID-weighted mean regional gain is descriptive only.
null: 999 seeded whole-profile permutations within each fixed level block; same draw used for k5 and k10. All edges involving a permuted node change jointly; no independent-edge t-test. p=(1+count macro normalized distance <= observed)/(1000), conservative float comparison tolerance1e-15.
interpretation: Approximate conditional exchangeability within same-region near-Total pairs/triples is assumed, not established; p is a conditional randomization diagnostic, not exact continuous covariate adjustment, sampling-based national inference, or causal evidence.
registered_joint_gate: December k5 region-equal gain>=.02 (a declared screening floor, not a validated utility threshold)
December k5 at least60% regional gains>0
December k5 gain without Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Sevastopol>0
adverse_result: Failure of any gate yields not_supported_by_registered_joint_gate; this does not prove absence of geography. Preserve/report every registered statistic.
sensitivity_limits: June road snapshot is later than June spending: retrospective association, not an as-of-June forecast
June and December have separately frozen near-Total supports; report exact intersection; not an identical-cohort or independent holdout replication
small regions, remote unconnected territories and shared centers excluded: no blanket national generalization
prohibited_claims: NCut or K3 improvement or promotion
